name: avegancafe-marketplace
description: My personal Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: kitchen-brigade
plugins.description: Lean, stack-agnostic multi-agent orchestration modeled on the brigade de cuisine. /chef routes to strategize / implement / workflow / diagnose; the chef runs the cast (sous-chef, cook, expediter). Bundles the yes-chef greenlight and dinner-rush concurrency skills.

plugins.name: beadwork
plugins.description: Everything for working in beads (bd): a live pane (mod) showing Claude's task list and your open beads, capture/triage logging, tight bead titles, and a hook that surfaces parent-epic status after bd state changes.

plugins.name: session-management
plugins.description: Keeps session titles in `feat|fix|chore(Scope): imperative summary` form: Haiku titles each session once from your first prompt, `/autoname` re-titles it from the session history on demand, `/session-title` shows the title. Public; installs over HTTPS.

plugins.name: avegancafe
plugins.description: Kyle's personal Claude plugin for one-offs: work-notes-vault (his private Obsidian work vault and its Granola + voice-recorder archives), /slurp (transcribe the USB voice recorder into that vault), hifi-h2 (tag and load music onto his Rockbox player), phone-push (push notifications to his phone, now or scheduled) and flipper-usb (drive his Flipper Zero over USB).

plugins.name: juliet
plugins.description: Shared Claude Code tooling for Juliet, the scripted macOS + Fedora setup: the noelle agent and the skills it preloads (juliet-config, juliet-extension, juliet-cross-platform, juliet-bootstrap-step, add-app-config, add-fish-alias). Moved out of Juliet's stowed ~/.claude.

plugins.name: duet
plugins.description: How Claude Duet works, for the agents running inside it: where plugins come from and when they load, threads vs sessions, how a channel's repos are attached (duet-basics), and when to give complex multi-task work its own channel coordinated through its Tasks list (channels-for-complex-work). Install to claude.ai chat plugins; grows as Duet behavior is learned.

plugins.name: linear-todos
plugins.description: Manage Kyle's Linear TODO team from Claude Duet through the Linear connector: add todos from plain text (eod/eow/eom dates, trailing !priority), list, done, snooze, and the morning digest and evening review. Instruction-only, no API key. Install to claude.ai chat plugins.

plugins.name: hairline
plugins.description: Hairline figures: isometric line-drawing animations that answer the pointer, as one self-contained HTML file. hairline-create draws one from an idea; hairline-adopt rebuilds an SVG as one. Vendored from Lucas Marques' MIT-licensed @lucasmarkes/hairline skills.
